name: io.github.nirholas/xactions
title: XActions
description: X/Twitter automation MCP: scrape, post, schedule, analyze, engage. No API key required.

environmentVariables.name: XACTIONS_SESSION_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: X/Twitter auth_token cookie. Without it the server runs on the guest tier: public profiles, tweets and threads work, while search, followers, bookmarks and DMs need this set. Capture it with `xactions login --from-browser <name>`.

environmentVariables.name: XACTIONS_CSRF_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The ct0 cookie that pairs with the auth_token. Required for search, bookmarks, direct messages and every write.

environmentVariables.name: XACTIONS_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated tool or group names to expose, for example `read,analytics`. All 151 tools load when unset, which costs roughly 16k tokens of context; a narrow list keeps a client's context small.

environmentVariables.name: XACTIONS_MCP_REQUIRE_APPROVAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hold every write tool as a draft instead of running it. Approve with the x_approve_draft tool or `xactions drafts approve`.
